finding: A keyless MCP tools/call of variant_brief still answers 200 with a real result: the constraints LiveVariant wants variants written against, including its rule that the first variant must be the control, and a nextStep pointing at build_test. This is an end-to-end use of one tool by a caller with no account, sixteen days after the 2026-09-23 reading and with the same substance, now with a transcript that carries the request and its sent time. It measures one tool; list_tests, called one second earlier, refused the same caller (companion record of the same minute).
